title: method smda via library(sparseLDA) ends up in R debugger
description:
Hi,
on request this caret (6.0-52) question is posted now here, I still have to figure out what that means, but here it is.

Topic: method smda via library(sparseLDA) ends up in R debugger

---

this is the code for with rf and binary and multi-class problem.

``` R
#---------------------------------
#  everything fine with rf

require(caret)
data(iris)

#Three class problem
TrainData <- iris[,1:4]
TrainClasses <- iris[,5]

rfFit <- train(TrainData, TrainClasses,
                method = "rf",
                preProcess = c("center", "scale"),
                tuneLength = 1,
                trControl = trainControl(method = "boot632"))
rfFit
confusionMatrix(rfFit)
confusionMatrix(rfFit, "average")

#  Results
#  Accuracy   Kappa      Accuracy SD  Kappa SD
```
